content.text: I wrote this from strd teaching for PANCE study, using your Blueprint answers where they apply (ex doxycycline for healthy outpt CAP, bismuth quadruple w/ tetracycline for H. pylori, azithro for Shigella and pertussis, amoxicillin for Lyme in preg). It isn't checked against your own notes or a single source. Doses and first-line choices Δ, so check current guidelines b4 using it for pt care.
